description: 现代 Windows 任务管理器 · A modern task manager for Windows, built with Rust and GPUI Kit.
pre_install: Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { try { $_.Path -like 'C:\Program Files\Argus Privileged\*' -or $_.Path -like 'C:\Program Files\Argus Runtime\*' } catch { $false } } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

foreach ($p in @('HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\taskmgr.exe','HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\taskmgr.exe')) { if (Test-Path $p) { $dbg = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -Name Debugger -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Debugger; if ($dbg -and $dbg -like '*Argus Privileged*') { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $p -Name Debugger -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }

$ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'; foreach ($d in @('C:\Program Files\Argus Privileged','C:\Program Files\Argus Runtime')) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d) { try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $d -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Move-Item -LiteralPath $d -Destination ("$d.old-$ts") -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }
pre_uninstall: Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { try { $_.Path -like 'C:\Program Files\Argus Privileged\*' -or $_.Path -like 'C:\Program Files\Argus Runtime\*' } catch { $false } } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

foreach ($p in @('HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\taskmgr.exe','HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\taskmgr.exe')) { if (Test-Path $p) { $dbg = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -Name Debugger -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Debugger; if ($dbg -and $dbg -like '*Argus Privileged*') { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $p -Name Debugger -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }

$ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'; foreach ($d in @('C:\Program Files\Argus Privileged','C:\Program Files\Argus Runtime')) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d) { try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $d -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Move-Item -LiteralPath $d -Destination ("$d.old-$ts") -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }
notes: Argus 的特权服务（ArgusPrivileged）与任务管理器替换组件装在 C:\Program Files\Argus Privileged / Argus Runtime，Scoop 不管理它们。安装/升级前会停用并删除旧服务、恢复 Windows 任务管理器（如果之前替换过），再清理这两个目录，由新版本首次启动时重新部署。需要管理员权限；非管理员安装会跳过清理。
升级后首次启动 Argus 会重新创建对应版本的特权组件；若之前开启了“替换任务管理器”，需在设置里重新开启。
